description: This file defines the 'Meal' result class for the Coocook schema, representing meal records in the database with associated methods for managing related dishes and meal properties.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Meal
classes.description: A DBIx::Class result class representing a meal, with relationships to dishes and methods for managing meal data.

methods.name: deletable
methods.description: Determines if the meal can be deleted, i.e., it has no associated dishes or prepared dishes.

methods.name: delete_dishes
methods.description: Deletes all dishes associated with the meal, except for prepared dishes.

methods.name: for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Prepares a hashref suitable for editing meal dishes, including related dishes and metadata.
